name: Set Payment Entry
script:
if doc.txn_status == "SUCCESS":
    doc1 = frappe.new_doc("Payment Entry")
    doc1.naming_series = "ACC-PAY-.YYYY.-"
    doc1.payment_type = "Receive"
    doc1.party_type = "Customer"
    doc1.party = doc.merchant_tran_id
    doc1.paid_amount = float(doc.payer_amount)
    doc1.mode_of_payment = "UPI"
    doc1.posting_date = frappe.utils.getdate(doc.txn_completion_date[:8])
    doc1.paid_from_account_currency = "INR"
    doc1.paid_to_account_currency = "INR"
    doc1.source_exchange_rate = 1
    doc1.base_paid_amount = float(doc.payer_amount)
    doc1.received_amount = float(doc.payer_amount)
    doc1.target_exchange_rate = 1
    doc1.base_received_amount = doc.payer_amount
    doc1.paid_to = frappe.get_doc("Mode of Payment","UPI").get("accounts")[0].default_account
    doc1.custom_icici_collection = doc.name
    doc1.insert()
    doc1.save()
    doc1.submit()
